exceptions.AppController+CAPI.m: defines +[AppController initialize], which Swift cannot declare, and the C globals with external linkage that Objective-C++ files read and plugins link (OsiriX, PapyrusLock, STORESCP, thumbnailsListPanel...)
exceptions.BLAuthentication+CAPI.m: calls AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges, deprecated since macOS 10.7, with the deprecation warning silenced around the call; Swift cannot silence a deprecation warning, and the function hands back FILE pointers and a fifo built with mkfifo
exceptions.BrowserController+Activity+CAPI.m: overrides -accessibilityRows of the activity table with NSAccessibilityElement rows; Swift types NSTableView's accessibilityRows as [NSAccessibilityRow], which these elements do not adopt
exceptions.BrowserController+CAPI.m: returns the static oneCopyAtATime literal, the same object the media copy of DicomDatabase synchronizes on (a Swift string is a different object); registers the Distributed Objects endpoint through NSInvocation, which Swift cannot use; and computes dates with IsiXDICOMCalendarDate through the NSCalendarDate methods it inherits, unavailable in Swift
exceptions.BrowserController+Sources+CAPI.m: implements HorosVolumeDiscovery, whose worker runs inside @try/@catch so that an Objective-C exception raised by a volume scan is logged instead of ending the app; Swift cannot catch an Objective-C exception
exceptions.CPRVolumeData+CAPI.m: compiles the inline samplers of CPRVolumeData.h with the target's C flags (-ffast-math in Release, -O3 in Debug), so the CPR samples keep the bits the Objective-C produced; Swift compiling those inline functions would round differently
exceptions.DCMPix+CAPI.m: returns the stored NSArray and NSData of -pixArray and -transferFunction as the same objects (a Swift override bridges them to copies, which callers comparing by identity would see); invokes AppController's 12-bit fill NSInvocation, which Swift cannot call; and keeps the C constant DCMPixAnnotationPatientNamePrefix
exceptions.DCMPix+NonDICOMCAPI.m: C entry points over the NIfTI reader, whose headers do not import into Swift, and the FluoView header struct for Swift; the libtiff calls are the TIFF adapter's
exceptions.DCMView+CAPI.m: declares and forwards the -drawCrossLines: and -computeSliceIntersection: methods with float[2][3] parameters, which Swift cannot declare; and defines the C globals and plane functions with external linkage that DICOMExport.mm (Objective-C++) calls
exceptions.DICOMPrint/Helper/HorosStoredPrintBridge: the DCMTK bridge of the print helper, a separate executable that BuildStoredPrint.sh compiles with clang++ against DCMTK's dcmpstat and links to its main.swift through a C-only header; it is outside the app target, so the app's DCMTK adapters cannot serve it; DCMTK reports its errors to it as OFCondition statuses
exceptions.DNDArrayController+CAPI.m: implements -tableView:writeRows:toPasteboard:, deprecated since macOS 10.4 and unavailable in Swift, which NSTableView still calls for the array controller's drags; and defines the exported pasteboard type names it writes
exceptions.DataNodeIdentifier.m: its description property, which nodes compare, sort and show and which may be nil, overrides -[NSObject description]; a Swift override must be a String that is never nil
exceptions.DicomDatabase+CAPI.m: overrides -release so that the registry of open databases, which does not retain them, is locked across the last release and the removal in dealloc, which Swift cannot override; implements +databaseAtPath:, +databaseAtPath:name: and +databaseForContext:, which Swift imports as initializers and cannot implement in an @implementation extension; exports the C constants with external linkage that Objective-C(++) files read, one of them computed at load; and wraps the variadic logging, DCMCalendarDate (an NSCalendarDate subclass unavailable in Swift) and the static inline helpers of the import that Objective-C++ files also use, which Swift cannot call
exceptions.DicomFile+CAPI.m: implements +newSeriesUID, a selector of the new family whose declaration says NS_RETURNS_NOT_RETAINED (callers, plugins included, take the autoreleased string); a Swift implementation returns +1 whatever the declaration says, which would leak the string at every call
exceptions.DicomImage+CAPI.m: implements the setters of the Core Data properties date and series whose getters Core Data generates; Swift cannot implement one half of a modelled property and leave the other to Core Data
exceptions.DicomSeries+CAPI.m: implements the accessors of Core Data properties (comments, stateText, date, study, images, thumbnail) whose other half Core Data generates; Swift cannot implement one half of a modelled property and leave the other to Core Data
exceptions.DicomStudy+CAPI.m: computes the ages by the calendar arithmetic of the IsiXDICOMFile date type through its Objective-C selectors, and draws the scrambled letters from random(), unavailable in Swift; soundex4 keeps its C name beside them
exceptions.DicomStudy+Report+CAPI.m: launches the ODT to PDF conversion inside @try/@catch, since NSTask raises Objective-C exceptions, and raises an NSException that its callers catch; Swift can neither catch nor raise across its frames safely
exceptions.HorosAlertPanel.m: defines the variadic C functions HorosRunAlertPanel, HorosRunInformationalAlertPanel and HorosRunCriticalAlertPanel that Objective-C callers, Nitrogen included, use; Swift cannot define a variadic C function
exceptions.HorosObjCException.m: catches NSException with @try/@catch for the Swift callers; Swift cannot catch an Objective-C exception
exceptions.IsiXPluginExceptionGuard.mm: catches, with a C++ try/catch, the C++ exceptions and other thrown objects that a plugin's command lets escape, around HorosObjCException for its NSExceptions, so that a plugin cannot end the application; Swift cannot catch a C++ exception
exceptions.MPRDCMView+CAPI.m: defines minimumStep, a C global with external linkage that VRView resets when it draws and after a full-depth capture and the Swift MPR and CPR views set; Swift cannot define a C global
exceptions.NSUserDefaults+OsiriX.m: defines the exported NSString defaults keys, C globals with external linkage that Objective-C files read, and the Decompress helper compiles it, and the helper builds no Swift of its own (it reaches Swift only through the internal modules it links), with its own OSIRIX_VIEWER and OSIRIX_LIGHT branches; Swift cannot define a C global
exceptions.Nitrogen/Sources/N2Debug+CAPI.m: defines _N2LogErrorImpl and N2LogStackTrace, the C functions with a variable argument list behind the N2LogError and N2LogStackTrace macros of the Objective-C files; Swift cannot define a C function that takes a variable argument list
defines N2ManagedObjectContextPerformAndWait, a C function with external linkage that Objective-C(++) files, Swift and plug-ins call, which catches on the context's queue the exception its block raised and raises it again off the queue (Swift can neither catch an Objective-C exception nor raise one across its frames); implements -newObjectForEntity:, a selector of the new family whose declaration says NS_RETURNS_NOT_RETAINED, which a Swift implementation would return retained; the context's -countForFetchRequest:error:, which answers NSNotFound with its error, a throwing method returning an integer that Swift cannot override; -objectsForEntity:predicate:error: and -performBlockAndWait:, which Swift imports with a placeholder error: () argument and as an optional non-escaping closure, and cannot implement; and the legacy -lock, -tryLock and -unlock of the context and of the database, which call NSManagedObjectContext's locks, deprecated since macOS 10.10, with the deprecation warning silenced, which Swift cannot do
exceptions.Nitrogen/Sources/N2View+CAPI.m: declares -layout and -setLayout: of N2View, which return and take its N2Layout; -layout is the selector of NSView's -layout, which returns void, and Swift cannot redeclare an inherited method with another type
exceptions.Notifications.m: defines the exported NSString notification names, C globals with external linkage that Objective-C and Objective-C++ files read; Swift cannot define a C global
exceptions.O2DicomPredicateEditorView+CAPI.m: declares -tag and -setTag: returning an IsiXDICOMAttributeTag; Swift cannot redeclare NSView's -tag selector with an object type
exceptions.OSIEnvironment+CAPI.m: makes OSIEnvironment a singleton by overriding +allocWithZone:, -retain, -release, -autorelease and -retainCount, which Swift does not allow a class to implement
exceptions.OSIROIMask+CAPI.m: boxes the OSIROIMaskRun and OSIROIMaskIndex structs in NSValue with @encode, which Swift cannot produce, and defines the qsort comparator and C functions with external linkage over those structs
exceptions.OSIVolumeWindow+CAPI.m: implements -floatVolumeDataForDimensionsAndIndexes:, a variadic method Swift cannot declare, and an -init that returns nil after the object exists, which a Swift initializer cannot do
exceptions.PluginManager+CAPI.m: is the one includer of the plugin helpers of HorosPluginLoadDiagnostics.h, HorosPluginSignature.h, HorosPluginInstall.h and HorosPluginCatalogTransport.h, static inline C functions written for manual retain/release, which the Swift class reaches through it
exceptions.VRView+CAPI.m: declares -draggingSourceOperationMaskForLocal:, the historical dragging-source selector of VRView.h, which Swift cannot declare (AppKit marks it unavailable); adopts HorosMPRVRViewMessages, the MPR's nonisolated public protocol, whose members are main-actor methods of the class that a Swift conformance would make public requirements crossing isolation; and adopts the VTK adapter's protocols for the Metal presenter and the ROI canvas, whose frame protocol passes NSData that Swift would bridge to Data while the presenter caches its buffers on the NSData objects it is given
exceptions.ViewerAutounbinderDetach+CAPI.m: clears the target of AppKit's private NSAutounbinder through the runtime's ivar offsets without retaining or releasing it; Swift's object_getIvar returns a strong reference, which would retain a controller that may already be freed
exceptions.ViewerController+CAPI.m: implements -newROI:, -newPoint:: and -copyViewerWindow, whose new and copy family results the callers receive autoreleased; Swift would return them retained and leak them; and defines the C globals delayedTileWindows and SyncButtonBehaviorIsBetweenStudies
exceptions.WebPortal+CAPI.m: defines +[WebPortal initialize], which Swift cannot declare: the class reads the portal's accounts path and observes its defaults before its first message, once for WebPortal and not again for the subclass KVO makes
exceptions.WebPortalConnection+Data+CAPI.m: returns the constant strings (__NSCFConstantString) "date", "main" and "studyList" that the portal stores as template tokens; the templates compare a token with a quoted string only when one's class is a kind of the other's, and a Swift literal bridges as a tagged pointer string, the class of the template's substring, so %[IF:backLink=="main"%] would change its answer
